# Synthetic fixtures

Hand-written for CalZone's tests; no personal data, no third-party files.
They cover what the household corpus (`fixtures/private/`, never committed)
lacks: Thunderbird per-user properties and overrides with EXDATE, recurring
and undated VTODOs, a custom VTIMEZONE (an Outlook-style name with 1601
onsets), vCard 3.0 with a folded base64 photo and LF line endings, and a
vCard 4.0 with a quoted TYPE list.
